content.short: Suiswap is a high-performance DEX hub on Sui that combines AMM liquidity pools with a limit order book.
content.description: Suiswap is a leading decentralized exchange and liquidity powerhouse built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with a seamless and highly efficient trading experience. The platform features a hybrid architecture that combines traditional Automated Market Maker (AMM) liquidity pools with a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB), allowing for more precise trade execution and minimal slippage. Suiswap serves as a primary liquidity hub for the Sui ecosystem, providing professional-grade trading tools. Suiswap also includes a decentralized aggregator to find the best possible rates.
content.meta: Suiswap provides high-speed hybrid trading and liquidity aggregation for the Sui blockchain. Discover Suiswap on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
